
```{r freq-context}
freq(as.ordered(df$OQ6), plot = FALSE)
```

#0Q6 as alcohol related context (empty beer bottles on sight) CONTEXT on PSTD as time informative interval, 1 is yes 2 is no.

```{r freq-context2}
freq(as.ordered(df$D53), plot = FALSE)

```

##drunk or intoxicated people on sight. 1 is yes, 2 is no.

```{r freq-context3}
freq.(as.ordered(df$D15_12))
```

#non related alcohol contest as D15-12, 1 is no drinking establishment, and 2 means other categories

`{df$OQ6[df$OQ6 == 1] <- "no"} freq(as.ordered(df$OQ6)`
